WITH RECURSIVE entity_levels AS (
    SELECT
        EntityKey,
        CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Int32)) AS ParentEntityKey,
        EntityName,
        0 AS hierarchy_level
    FROM retail.DimEntity
    WHERE ParentEntityKey IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        e.EntityKey,
        toInt32OrNull(e.ParentEntityKey) AS ParentEntityKey,
        e.EntityName,
        el.hierarchy_level + 1 AS hierarchy_level
    FROM retail.DimEntity AS e
    INNER JOIN entity_levels AS el
        ON toInt32OrNull(e.ParentEntityKey) = el.EntityKey
),
ancestor_map AS (
    SELECT
        EntityKey AS descendant_entity_key,
        EntityKey AS ancestor_entity_key
    FROM retail.DimEntity

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        am.descendant_entity_key,
        toInt32(e.ParentEntityKey) AS ancestor_entity_key
    FROM ancestor_map AS am
    INNER JOIN retail.DimEntity AS e
        ON am.ancestor_entity_key = e.EntityKey
    WHERE e.ParentEntityKey IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    el.hierarchy_level,
    el.EntityKey,
    el.EntityName,
    sum(fos.SalesAmount) AS total_sales
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s
    ON fos.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
INNER JOIN ancestor_map AS am
    ON toInt32(s.EntityKey) = am.descendant_entity_key
INNER JOIN entity_levels AS el
    ON am.ancestor_entity_key = el.EntityKey
GROUP BY
    el.hierarchy_level,
    el.EntityKey,
    el.EntityName
ORDER BY
    el.hierarchy_level,
    total_sales DESC,
    el.EntityKey;
